name: PUCV al Cubo 2025
information:
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTAyMDgsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--9bc12900f1c6c77b14344044263277118242dc78/Dise%C3%B1o%20sin%20t%C3%ADtulo%20(3).png)


**Español** Nos complace anunciar la primera competencia de speedcubing de la Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso, esperamos poder recibir a la mayor cantidad de competidores posibles y que este sea un evento emocionante para competidores, familia y amigos. Los esperamos ansiosos!!!

**English** We are pleased to announce the first speedcubing competition at the Pontificia Universidad Católica de Valparaíso. We hope to welcome as many competitors as possible and make this an exciting event for competitors, family, and friends. We look forward to seeing you there!
